title: Electrical Technology Viva Questions
text:
Electrical technology is one subject that haunts every chemsem faccha. Its dreaded claws almost never miss a direct one hit K.O on our C.G. Along with its best arsenal, comes the Grand Viva.

This page was created with an intention to do the same. Below are a collection of questions asked during the Grand Viva in Electrical Technology lab. The page is under construction and requires your support to achieve its full caliber. 

General Questions

These questions are commonly asked in almost every Grand Viva and you are expected to be well aware of them.

!You might have guessed that all the graphs and instrument/apparatus characteristics are important. Do be aware of every single significance of the graph (Why certain peaks occur, why the falls occur, Why the slope is negative/positve etc)
!Link to ET tutorials page

!3
!What does MI and MC stand for in types of Ammeter, Voltmeter etc? Why are the named this way? Explain their differences.
!Link to answer

!4
!Normal questions on what the general parts of instruments are. This can cover the connection portion, internal working of a Wattmeter. The physical significance of lines that orginate from a DPST switch.
!
